description: NIST's FTC-11 AP242 e2 solid #1299 (the slot chain of blend/nist-ftc-11-ap242-bspline-circle-fillet) turned and moved by the pose the nightly's slot-chain property shrank to (rotation about (-0.6726563463311865, -0.312194281374221, 0.6708712025550156) by 157.83007892511384 degrees, then moved by (-95.06916248407532, 0, 0)), its e2 edge filleted at the battery's radius 0.0105. The pose is the property's shrunk one rounded to an axis and angle that fail the same way: the failure is a knife-edge, one ulp of the axis flips it, and it holds at every radius tried from 0.0042 to 0.0105. Unturned the chain is clean; in this pose the blend's output fails the checker at V3, v99 and v100 (the pcurve ends of f42) 2.5e-3 off their surface. The property's own radius 0.004 is not used because Open CASCADE's fillet there is not a closed surface (odd Euler characteristic), so the fixture would have no oracle. The desired result is a checker-green body that matches Open CASCADE's (plans/nightly-panics step 2)
